original_document.title: Marketing Calls CNAM | Display Your Company Name Instead of Phone Number | Telecom Egypt - TE Business - Telecom Egypt

chunks.text: Marketing calls (CNAM) service enables you to register your company's Name or company's Name + short number when calling your customers instead of land line number. Features: - Show company Name only instead of land line number. - Or Show company Name + short number. Channels to Get Marketing calls service: - For commercial individual land line customer: Subscription from WE Stores. - For short number subscribers: VIP customers service center at 2 New Nady st., New Maadi. For more information, please call 111. Prices are Tax-exclusive.
